newsitem.title: USA: Ault sees record FY98 despite weak Q1.
newsitem.headline: Ault sees record FY98 despite weak Q1.

text.p: Ault Inc said Monday it expects fiscal 1998 to be its fourth consecutive year of record operating results, despite expected weakness in the first quarter.

"The company's performance in the first quarter ending August 31 will again by affected by normal seasonal factors, which should make this period Ault's weakest quarter of the coming year, as it was in fiscal 1997 and the preceding three years," said chief executive Frederick Green.
However, he said, "sales and earnings comparisons with the first quarter of fiscal 1996 are still expected to be positive," Green said.

The manufacturer of external power conversion products reported net income of $1.3 million on net sales of $11.5 million for the fourth quarter ended June 1, compared to year-ago net income of $351,000 on net sales of $10.2 million.
